gen.title: Deriving force from momentum change
gen.orderNote: Steps follow the page order of the derivation

steps.label: change in momentum
steps.quote: His second law defines a force to be equal to change in momentum (mass times velocity) per change in time.
steps.orderHint: follow the derivation as it appears on the page

steps.label: F = (m1 * V1 – m0 * V0) / (t1 – t0)
steps.orderHint: follow the derivation as it appears on the page

steps.label: mass stays at a constant value equal to m
steps.quote: Let us assume that the mass stays at a constant value equal to m.
steps.orderHint: follow the derivation as it appears on the page

steps.label: F = (m * (V1 – V0)) / (t1 – t0)
steps.orderHint: follow the derivation as it appears on the page

steps.label: definition of the acceleration a
steps.quote: The change in velocity divided by the change in time is the definition of the acceleration a.
steps.orderHint: follow the derivation as it appears on the page

steps.label: F = m * a
steps.orderHint: follow the derivation as it appears on the page
